clusters.description: Jon Anik says on his Anik Bros channel there are 'internal conversations' in the UFC about an immediate Gaethje vs Topuria rematch
UFC fans on social media blast the rumoured Gaethje-Topuria rematch after Anik's leak ('a disgrace')
clusters.doubt: Could be read as just another write-up of Anik's remarks with fan quotes as colour, rather than a separate reaction story.

clusters.description: Paddy Pimblett, ringside in Dublin (Eze Obas interview), says he'd 'love to smash Topuria's head in' but nobody has called him; lists Arman/Gaethje/Ruffy/Charles and hopes for December
clusters.doubt: 843's body is only Yahoo nav junk (merged on headline plus the Dublin photo caption); 913's visible body is an options analysis and its Pimblett quote only appears in the headline.

clusters.description: Tim Welch on Sean O'Malley's podcast says there are rumours of Pimblett vs Topuria in December; O'Malley says he leans Paddy
clusters.doubt: 896 is mostly a history of the Pimblett-Topuria feud and only carries the O'Malley quote in its headline.

clusters.description: Estadio Deportivo recap of Topuria's letter to his son / essay after the Gaethje loss, padded with his older quotes on handling defeat
clusters.doubt: It is about the essay (an event from days earlier, not in this batch) but no other article here is a straight report of that essay.

clusters.description: MARCA review of Spanish fighters' 2026 in the UFC: debutants Hecher Sosa and Fabia Sintes save the year; Topuria only mentioned
Joe Rogan on the JRE MMA Show warns Topuria not to rush back after the Gaethje damage, citing Volkanovski's quick return as the cautionary example
clusters.doubt: 866 quotes different Rogan sentences (via an X clip) than 917/926 quote from JRE MMA Show #185; I assumed one episode, but it could be two separate Rogan occasions.

clusters.description: Matt Brown on The Fighter vs The Writer podcast says an immediate Gaethje rematch could 'ruin Ilia Topuria's life'; suggests a tune-up like Moicano first
Josh Hokit's X tirade saying neither Topuria nor Pereira deserves a title shot next, triggered by Pereira's video asking for a Gane rematch
clusters.doubt: 909 is framed entirely around Pereira and its visible body never names Topuria; merged because the same tweet series names both men.

clusters.description: Topuria's new message to Georgian fans in a TBC advert: 'my greatest victories are still to come', promises to return stronger
Arman Tsarukyan tells Paramount he wants to beat Makhachev's lightweight defence record; Topuria only mentioned in the headline
Justin Gaethje on Demetrious Johnson's podcast dissects the Topuria win: 'terrible emotional mistakes', feet never change rhythm, 'he forgot who he was'

uncertain_pairs.why: The Sun piece could be one story with the Anik report, since its news peg is Anik's leak and the fan quotes are just reaction colour.
ABC's visible body is an analysis of Topuria's two options leaning on Anik's rematch claim; only the headline carries the Pimblett quote, so it could belong with the Anik story or stand alone.
Yahoo's body is pure nav junk; I merged on the headline and the Dublin ringside photo caption, which matches the Pimblett interview but is not text evidence.
Both are Rogan warning Topuria about coming back too soon, but they quote different sentences and 866 cites an X clip rather than JRE #185, so they might be two occasions.
Yahoo's piece is about Hokit vs Pereira and could be an 'about somebody else' singleton; I merged because it is the same tweet series that names Topuria.
Estadio Deportivo is mostly feud history with the O'Malley quote only in the headline; it could be split off as its own explainer rather than a report of the Welch/O'Malley podcast.
